messages:
maria (AE): Hi team — UmbrellaCo legal asked for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 cert, and a signed pen-test commitment for their 2-week POC. They also want a short note confirming isolation levels for the POC environment. Can we assemble and send today?
dave (solutions-eng): We have the SOC2 and ISO PDFs in the compliance bucket. I can create a redacted bundle and a one-page infra note about staging vs dedicated.
maria (AE): Great. They might request staging credentials. Any policy blockers on providing those?
dave (solutions-eng): Staging creds ok for standard POCs. If they demand reserved GPUs, that's a Dedicated POC and requires a short-term reserved commitment (procurement). I'll call that out in the note.
elaine (security): Quick clarification: we don't sign pen-test letters before scope is agreed. We provide a Pen-Test Intent/Attestation template and coordinate once UmbrellaCo signs a testing agreement. I'll upload the template to secure share.
maria (AE): They'll probably push for something signed asap. Please paste your attestation snippet here so I can forward while we finalize.
elaine (security): Snippet: "Redwood Inference confirms maintenance of SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. We will coordinate third-party penetration testing upon execution of a mutually agreed testing engagement that defines scope, timing, and responsibilities."
compliance-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/umbrella/2026-02-24/evidence_bundle.zip (expires in 7 days)
tom (sales-eng): Pricing note: If UmbrellaCo wants a 2-week Dedicated pool (small), ballpark internal is $10k-$16k depending on region and GPU type. I can produce a formal quote if they confirm dedicated.
dave (solutions-eng): I'll assemble: redacted_SOC2.pdf, ISO27001_cert.pdf, pen-test-intent.docx, POC_isolation_note.md, POC_checklist.xlsx. ETA: 3pm PT today.
maria (AE): Please include a short checklist for their security team: point of contact, preferred test window, IP ranges, scope exclusions (no social engineering), and expected delivery dates.
elaine (security): Added checklist items. Also note: if UmbrellaCo requests penetration testing of Dedicated infra, we require a joint-run of the test window and a 72hr notification SLA for critical findings.
maria (AE): Thanks. Once bundle is up I'll send with suggested timeline: review by EOW, sign test agreement early next week, start POC mid-next week.
dave (solutions-eng): Bundle uploaded to secure share: https://secure.redwood.com/share/umbrella/def456 (expires in 7 days).
elaine (security): Reviewed bundle, redactions look good. Legal approved the intent wording. Remind client we sign the final attestation post-engagement.
maria (AE): Sending now. I'll attach the dedicated PO quote if they ask for committed capacity. Closing thread after confirmation from UmbrellaCo. :white_check_mark:
